name: Saoirse O'Malley
bio:
Saoirse O'Malley is a seasoned motorsport professional, currently serving as the Head of Operations for 23XI Racing. Her journey into the racing world began unexpectedly when a university project required her to analyze the pit stop strategies of Formula 1 teams. Intrigued by the blend of technical precision and strategic decision-making, she pursued a career in motorsport operations, starting as a data analyst before working her way up through various operational roles.

As Head of Operations, Saoirse focuses on ensuring seamless execution across all aspects of the team, from logistics and scheduling to resource allocation and performance analysis. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to identify and resolve potential bottlenecks before they impact performance. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to excellence, and she believes that consistent improvement is the key to success in the competitive world of motorsport. Saoirse is distinctive for her blend of hard-nosed practicality and innovative problem-solving.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a low ponytail
physical.description: Saoirse has a sharp, focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, with everything in its designated place.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought, a sound that drives some of her colleagues crazy.
